75.long: Walk left. In the car: drive on, and letting go coasts.

77.long: Walk right. In the car: brake.

72.long: Climb up a ladder, or hop up on a hop level.

80.long: Climb down a ladder. In the car: back up gently.

57.long: Jump, or reach up into the block over your hat. In the car: toot the horn.

32.long: Same as the Right arrow. In Oil's Well: squirt a drop into the fourth line.

16.long: Hop up and to the left.

18.long: Hop up and to the right. In Oil's Well: squirt a drop into the first line.

71.long: Same as Q: hop up and to the left.

73.long: Same as E: hop up and to the right.

33.long: Oil's Well: squirt a drop into the fifth line.

34.long: Oil's Well: squirt a drop into the second line.

48.long: Oil's Well: squirt a drop into the third line. In Pump Up the Volume: twist a balloon.

1.long: Jump, reach up, or toot the horn.

counters.20: Red clamp, fans switched on, or the last station tuned
counters.21: Black clamp, brake lamps lit, tapes fetched, or the radio
counters.22: The battery's charge, the ball found, or the tire's air
counters.23: Spark plugs plucked, or raindrops rung
counters.24: Notes played on the beat, or horn pads honked

sounds.12: A reach: crank ratchet or key boop
sounds.13: Oil can line 1, a trick or a twist
